highlights: AI-native tooling - The Nx CLI is optimized for autonomous AI agents so they get the context they need and can operate just like a human.
Polyglot plugin system - Optional plugins auto-discover tasks, configure cache inputs/outputs, and scaffold code based on your actual tooling.

Integrated CI solution - Connect Nx to your CI provider (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure, etc.) to enable remote caching, task distribution across machines, affected-only runs, and automatic e2e test splitting.
Self-healing CI - An AI agent on your CI pipeline that detects failures, analyzes root cause, proposes a fix, and verifies it automatically.
Local agents connect to CI via MCP to autonomously detect and fix failures.
